candidate_precision: two float32 words per scalar/tangent; effective extended significand, not ordinary one-word FP32

generation.algorithm: Independent NumPy PCG64 generator; column-wise (random permutation + uniform jitter)/128 Latin hypercube; quantize once to float32

candidate_independent_validity: Independent 80-digit literal boundary at x=0 must be finite/positive and independent boundary cashflow < -64*eps32*max(1,scale), using inherited scale. Rejections are retained and are not numerical passes; candidate rejection of a valid point is a failure.
state_preparation: Compute prescribed state locations independently, quantize once to float32; same represented inputs passed to candidate and oracle.

gates.required: Every valid point/state must pass; all failures and rejections retained.

retuning_rule: Any candidate retuning after opening these results requires a new version and a new independent validation set. V1 failure evidence remains immutable.

cost_plan.inputs: Original 18 registered parameter cases, each at log-distance .001 and .1 and fixed asset100, all inputs quantized once to FP32
cost_plan.whole_evaluation: Boundary plus all five outputs and all ten Jacobian columns; compensated candidate versus original FP64 and original single-FP32 on identical represented inputs
cost_plan.reuse_evaluation: Separately report same three states with one prebuilt differentiated boundary per parameter case
cost_plan.timing: One warmup, one complete measurement per mode/order, wall and CPU time, no GPU claim

scientific_scope: Independent numerical validation of the declared finite financial operator. No R14 task confirmation changes, ordinary FP32 admission, uniform box theorem, production/GPU or learning-utility claim.
